embeds.rule: An ARRAY keyed by EAV_ID, not a subdocument keyed by attr_name: 187 (entity_id, attr_name) pairs carry more than one row (up to 3) across the 8,333 rows / 7,075 customers that have attributes, so a keyed subdocument would keep one value per pair and silently drop the rest. EAV_ID is also what makes the array value-gradable — the harness grades elements by a single-column key.
